title: SVG regression includes unsupported MIME format string and unwraps its error
severity: Test-only gate failure; not a production format regression

negative_proof.stderr: vectorcraft-cli: document.serialize: invalid parameters for `document.serialize`: unknown format `image/svg+xml` (see document.formats)

cause: encode_all calls writable; format accepts ids/extensions (case and leading dots), not MIME. SVG extensions is [svg]; image/svg+xml is only its declared mime field.
recommended_test_correction: Replace image/svg+xml with a supported dot/case alias such as .SVG. Do not broaden format API solely to satisfy this test.

warning_assertion.previous_gap: Save adds a fidelity warning even for available sources; asserting an empty warning list was wrong.
warning_assertion.current_disposition: Addressed by parent r5: assertion now checks only the placed-document preview warning.

warnings: SVG keeps the artwork but not everything a VectorCraft document holds (editable effects, symbols, swatches, styles): save as VectorCraft to keep it all editable

new_svg_production_runtime: Pending parent current-source gate; cached CLI predates SVG preparation-boundary change.
